purpose: Teach: 指針/区分/補正/集約/選考/単価/助手/裁量

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 仕入指針、集約と分散、両方の選択肢、用意して。
lines.en: Prep both consolidation and dispersion options for procurement guidance.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Sharp attack on the first word. No wasted breath. Matter-of-fact, the tone of someone delegating work she trusts will get done. Brief forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。区分ごとに単価補正を入れています。
lines.en: Yes. I've applied unit-price corrections for each category.
lines.style: Professional, attentive. Slight nod in the voice — confirming he understood and acted. Steady pace, no hesitation. Shows competence without self-promotion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 選考の最終判断、裁量で進めてOK。
lines.en: For final selection — you can decide how to proceed.
lines.style: Warm delegation. Not a question, not an order — permission with real weight behind it. Clear articulation of trust. Slight pause before the final phrase, like handing over the keys.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助手と一緒に、本日中にまとめます。
lines.en: I'll have it compiled with my assistant by end of day.
lines.style: Assured and lean. No filler. Steady eye-contact level commitment. The tone of someone confirming a promise he'll keep. Slight finality at the period.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Warm but brief. Genuine gratitude, not performed. Slight softening of the previous briskness. The acknowledgment that lands and lets people move forward.
